definitions.explanation: The routine, scheduled operation of public transportation such as buses, trains, ferries, or flights, running on a fixed timetable along established routes.

examples.japanese: このバスは{定期|ていき}{運行|うんこう}している。
examples.english: This bus runs on a regular schedule.

examples.japanese: {台風|たいふう}の{影響|えいきょう}で{定期|ていき}{運行|うんこう}が{中止|ちゅうし}された。
examples.english: Regular service was suspended due to the typhoon.

examples.japanese: {離島|りとう}へのフェリーは{週|しゅう}に{3便|さんびん}の{定期|ていき}{運行|うんこう}が{行|おこな}われており、{島民|とうみん}の{生活|せいかつ}を{支|ささ}えている。
examples.english: Ferries to the remote island run three scheduled services per week, supporting the islanders' daily lives.

notes:
A compound of {定期|ていき} (regular, scheduled) and {運行|うんこう} (operation, running). Used for all forms of scheduled public transportation.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {定期|ていき}{運行|うんこう}する: to operate on a regular schedule
- {定期|ていき}{運行|うんこう}を{再開|さいかい}する: to resume regular service
- {定期|ていき}{運行|うんこう}を{中止|ちゅうし}する: to suspend regular service
- {定期|ていき}{運行|うんこう}ダイヤ: regular service timetable
- {定期|ていき}{運行|うんこう}{路線|ろせん}: regular service route

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {臨時|りんじ}{運行|うんこう}: special/temporary service — extra runs outside the regular schedule
- {運行|うんこう}: operation, service — the general term without specifying regularity
- {定期便|ていきびん}: scheduled flight/service — often used for air and sea transport
